name: Enshrouded
description: Dedicated server for the survival game Enshrouded.
about: Runs the Windows Enshrouded dedicated server on Linux through Proton. Requires an x86-64 host. The first start downloads the game into the data folder. The container allows 120 seconds for shutdown so the server can save the world. Server settings and group passwords are reapplied on startup.

variables.label: Data folder
variables.description: Holds game files, world saves, logs, and server config. The container resets ownership to its steam user on startup.

variables.label: Game port
variables.description: The port players connect on. The server is told the same number, so it is published unchanged on the host.

variables.label: Query port
variables.description: The port the Steam server browser queries.

variables.label: Admin password
variables.description: Password for the Admin group, which can kick, ban, and access inventories. Reapplied on startup.

variables.label: Guest password
variables.description: Password for players joining the Guest group. Reapplied on startup.

variables.label: Update on start
variables.description: Checks for a new game build every time the container starts.

variables.label: Automatic updates
variables.description: Checks for game updates on the schedule, stopping and restarting the server when an update is available.

variables.label: Update schedule
variables.description: Cron schedule the automatic update runs on.

variables.label: Webhook URL
variables.description: Receives server status notifications. A Discord channel webhook works here. Leave blank to send none.
